name: Sargodha

queries.query: سرگودھا اراضی ریکارڈ سنٹر تحصیل سرگودھا زمین ریکارڈ سرکاری
queries.scope: Identify first-party Sargodha cadastral-record service and local record office.
queries.result: District Revenue Office lists the Arazi Record Center Tehsil Sargodha; PLRA notification states computerized record-of-rights work and current registers are held at the local center. The PULSE public map has a Sargodha district cadastral layer.

queries.query: Sargodha Pakistan official land records cadastral map public PULSE Sargodha parcel GIS
queries.scope: Cross-check official city-bound service and public geometry endpoint.
queries.result: Official PULSE viewer source references Punjab Cadastral Maps MapServer and its Sargodha sublayer; the Sargodha feature layer returns full polygon geometry at the WUP point through its public-reader bootstrap token.

portals.name: Arazi Record Center Tehsil Sargodha
portals.operator: District Administration Sargodha / Punjab Land Records Authority
portals.observation: Official district revenue office lists the Tehsil Sargodha record center. PLRA notice documents computerized record-of-rights and current registers at that local center.

portals.name: PULSE public land information system
portals.operator: Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement Project / PLRA
portals.observation: Public viewer lists Sargodha and cadastral/parcels layers. Viewer disclaimer says mapped lines are indicative rather than a legal boundary; complete parcel details require login. Public-reader GIS token bootstrap is available from the viewer.

requests.observation: Public viewer shell; source identifies ArcGIS REST services and explicitly offers Continue as Public User.
Intended viewer token bootstrap returned a short-lived public-reader token; token value not retained.
Metadata identifies the Sargodha Feature Layer, geometry type Polygon, EPSG:3857 source, object ID field OBJECTID, 2,000 max records; sensitive parcel fields were not queried.

Three bounded point queries requested only OBJECTID plus full geometry, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326. Exact WUP point hit one polygon; other two bounded nearby checks also returned one full polygon each. No owner, address, title, tax, or parcel attribute values requested.

source.name: Punjab Cadastral Maps — Sargodha Feature Layer
source.operator: Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement Project / Punjab Land Records Authority; district record custodian is the Sargodha Arazi Record Center.
source.serviceType: Public ArcGIS REST MapServer query using viewer-provided public-reader token bootstrap.
source.outputCrs: WGS 84 longitude/latitude requested; service layer metadata source EPSG:3857
source.nativeIdEvidence: Layer schema declares OBJECTID as OID; geometry-only spatial responses returned IDs 8559909, 8559606, and 7308181.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Sargodha local revenue office and PLRA records establish city-bound registry activity. PULSE Sargodha layer returned a full parcel polygon at the exact WUP point and two nearby checks. Portal describes its map lines as indicative and says complete parcel details require login; no legal-boundary or citywide completeness claim is made.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official Sargodha local revenue office and PLRA records establish city-bound registry activity. PULSE Sargodha layer returned a full parcel polygon at the exact WUP point and two nearby checks. Portal describes its map lines as indicative and says complete parcel details require login; no legal-boundary or citywide completeness claim is made.

technicalBlocker: Public-viewer bootstrap and safe ArcGIS geometry reads pass without account login. Thirteen bounded cells, forced paging, all seven fresh OIDs, absence, and a 16.8 m² WUP-centered site pass. Full sampled parcel footprints fail closed: one envelope count is 11 but its ID manifest has 10 entries; the smallest tested envelope count is 8 but has 7 IDs. Arbitrary footprint lookup and source binding therefore remain unqualified. No runtime source is enabled. All seven sampled full geometries are valid and distinct with no material overlap in EPSG:32643. Viewer notices and non-legal OBJECTID identity are informational; no token value is retained.
remainingUncertainty: PULSE map is explicitly indicative, not a legal boundary; no authoritative boundary or completeness assurance. Geometry ID is service OBJECTID rather than legal parcel identifier.
nextStep: Retain complete-manifest failures for publisher review; qualify arbitrary footprint retrieval before implementing a bounded public-token runtime wrapper.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

verifiedParcelResponse.requestSemantics: ArcGIS MapServer layer query: where=1=1, geometry=<point>, geometryType=esriGeometryPoint, inSR=4326, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects, outFields=OBJECTID, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=4. Layer metadata advertises pagination and maxRecordCount 2,000; citywide enumeration completeness not tested.
